title: Minecraft Night Survival!
story_hook: The sun is setting, Explorer! A dark night is coming. You need to build a shelter and survive until morning. This is a Minecraft challenge!

tasks.instruction: Explorer, gather 5 sticks and 3 stones. Use your hands to find them near the trees. This is a key resource!
Now, Explorer, use the stones to build a small block. Make it about 6 inches square. Use your hands to place the stones carefully.
Explorer, find 4 leaves. Use them to cover part of your block. This will help protect you from the night.
Explorer, look around. What kind of tree biome are we in? Observe the shapes of the trees and leaves. Use your crayon to draw a picture of what you see.

finale: You have survived the night, Explorer! You built a shelter and observed the world around you. Great job!
